title: PrestaShop Variables
description: Configuration variables for deploying and serving the PrestaShop e-commerce web application.

PRESTASHOP_PHP_FPM_LISTEN.description: PHP-FPM upstream FastCGI socket path or host:port endpoint serving PrestaShop.

PRESTASHOP_DB_TYPE.description: Relational database engine type used by PrestaShop (e.g., mysql, mariadb).

PRESTASHOP_WEBSERVER.description: Frontend web server component fronting PrestaShop (e.g., nginx, caddy, httpd).

PRESTASHOP_DB_USER.description: Database username used by PrestaShop to connect to its backing store.

PRESTASHOP_WWWROOT.description: Filesystem document root directory where PrestaShop application files are staged.

PRESTASHOP_VERSION.description: Target PrestaShop release version or alias (e.g., latest) to deploy.

PRESTASHOP_LISTEN.description: HTTP listen address:port or UNIX socket endpoint configured for PrestaShop.

PRESTASHOP_SERVER_NAME.description: Public virtual host domain name configured for the PrestaShop storefront.

PRESTASHOP_DB_NAME.description: Database schema name created for PrestaShop e-commerce tables.

PRESTASHOP_DB_PASS.description: Database password authenticating the PrestaShop database user.
